offering_description.value: Provides technology, equipment and services to oil and gas producers for reservoir characterization, drilling, well construction, completion and production. Also sells digital, data-center and decarbonization solutions. Delivers through field crews, manufacturing sites, software and project contracts to national oil companies, majors and independents.

primary_products.value: drilling tools and bits; completion equipment; production systems and artificial lift; surface and subsea equipment; software and data platforms

primary_services.value: drilling and measurement services; well construction and completion; reservoir evaluation and wireline; well stimulation and intervention; digital and data-center solutions

customer_segment.value: B2B: national oil companies, international oil majors, independent exploration and production companies

end_markets.value: oil and gas exploration and production; digital and data-center infrastructure; carbon capture and new energy; geothermal and lithium

revenue_model.value: service fees: drilling, evaluation, completion and intervention work billed by job or day rate; product sales: completion, production and drilling equipment sold to operators; project or contract: integrated multi-year well and production projects; licensing or royalties: software licenses and subscriptions for subsurface and digital platforms
revenue_model.category: service fees; product sales; project or contract; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: service provider: field services to oil and gas operators using own crews and equipment; OEM / manufacturer: manufactures downhole tools and production equipment from purchased materials, sold to operators; software / platform: subsurface and digital software sold to energy companies
value_chain_position.category: service provider; OEM / manufacturer; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: Operates in about 100 countries including North America, Latin America, Middle East, Europe, Africa and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: drilling, completion, production, reservoir evaluation, digital and new energy services sharing energy customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams contracting directly with oil companies and national operators

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: oilfield operations under environmental, safety, export control and sanctions rules, plus local content requirements

notes: Recent portfolio changes (e.g., ChampionX acquisition) may not be fully reflected.
